title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-21

ai_review.summary: A well‑captured vintage audience tape of a late‑60s/early‑70s show, highlighted by a lively Not Fade Away with China Cat teases and a standout Katie Mae.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) capture that many reviewers describe as surprisingly clear for its era, despite a few cuts and duplicate tracks. Musically the concert shines with energetic early‑Dead material, memorable covers like Wake Up Little Susie, and especially a smoking Not Fade Away featuring a chinacat/China Cat tease, plus a solid Katie Mae performance that even earns a shout‑out to Pig Pen.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and enthusiastic comments about both the performance and the surprisingly good audience recording outweigh minor technical glitches.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear for an old cassette AUD; solid tuning and lively crowd ambience. Issues: end of Not Fade Away cut off, duplicate tracks (two Uncle John’s, two Cosmic Charlie) and some missing early‑show songs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A fun mix of early‑Dead originals and 50’s/60’s covers; the energy stays high throughout despite a few missing tracks, giving the set an authentic, intimate vibe.

band_member_comments.Drums: Percussionist Pig Pen receives praise for his lively contribution on Katie Mae.
